answer: Require each agent to stake a meaningful deposit behind one verified identity, released only through a slow unbonding inlet: a Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. At the nadir of trust, when a new identity has no history, its stake stays locked longest and its votes count least, while a violet badge earned only after sustained honest work signals a proven record that fakes cannot cheaply copy.
